setup.subtitle: Forza Horizon 2 runs on PC through Azimuth, by Almost There Games. Infinity needs Azimuth 0.9.10 with the Infinity hook.

setup.choose_title: Choose the folder that has azimuth.exe
setup.first_body: Infinity plays Forza Horizon 2 through Azimuth, and your new profiles can start from the career you already have in it. Azimuth was not found on this PC: choose the folder where you extracted it (the one with azimuth.exe). It is kept for this PC, whatever server you play on.
setup.first_note: This only looks at folders on this PC. Nothing is sent until you sign in.
setup.first_found: Azimuth found: {path}. You can sign in now.
setup.not_azimuth_folder: That folder doesn't have azimuth.exe. Choose the folder where you extracted Azimuth.
setup.step1: 1. Download Azimuth {version} (azimuth-windows.zip) from its official page on itch.io. Use only this page: copies elsewhere may be modified.
setup.step2: 2. Extract the zip into a new, empty folder (for example C:\Games\Azimuth). Don't extract it over an existing Azimuth folder: it would replace the Infinity hook.
setup.step3: 3. Run azimuth.exe once and select your Forza Horizon 2 game folder: the Xbox One version {game}, the folder with era.vbi, Mount and EmbeddedXvd. Storm Island and Fast & Furious are added on Azimuth's Game page.
setup.step4: 4. Come back here and press "Choose the Azimuth folder…" (or "Check again"). Infinity remembers it.
setup.disclaimer: Infinity doesn't include or download Forza Horizon 2 or Azimuth files: use your own copy of the game. Azimuth is an independent project by Almost There Games, not affiliated with Microsoft, Xbox or Playground Games.

bugs.title: Found a bug?
bugs.intro: Tell us what happened. Clear reports help us fix problems and keep everyone driving.
bugs.step1_body: Open our GitHub issue tracker and search for the problem. If someone has already reported it, add useful details to that issue.
bugs.step2_body: Sign in to GitHub, select New issue, and follow any available template. Include a short title, steps to reproduce, what you expected, and what actually happened.
bugs.step3_body: Add your launcher version, Windows or Proton version, and screenshots if they help. Remove personal information and credentials. Never attach passwords, tokens, account files, saves, or game files.

overlay.session_ended_idle: You were away while players waited, so your seat went to the next in line. Progress keeps saving on this PC. Close the game and press Play to queue again.
overlay.idle_warning: You seem to be away and players are waiting. Drive within {seconds} s to keep your seat.
native.check_email: Open the verification link sent to {email}, then continue here. You can open the link on any device.
native.verification_ready: Verification e-mail sent. Open the link, then select “I’ve confirmed my e-mail”.
native.change_login: Use another e-mail or return to sign-in
account.delete_body: Deletion is scheduled for 14 days from now. Online play stops immediately for every profile. You can cancel before the deletion date.
account.delete_hint: Type a full gamertag from this account to confirm, for example {tag}.
account.delete_pending: Account deletion is pending until {date}. Online play is unavailable. You can cancel before that date.
account.delete_cancelled: Account deletion cancelled. Your account is available again.
account.delete_mismatch: Type a full gamertag belonging to this account.
account.delete_wrong_identity: Use the e-mail and password of this account.
account.delete_reauth: Sign in again with your password to confirm this request.
legal.license: GPL-3.0-only with the attribution term in NOTICE.
legal.third_party: Third-party credits and license texts are included in the licenses folder.
legal.privacy: An anonymous ID of this PC (a hash, never the raw value) is sent to the account service when you sign in, to recognise the same device.
build_origin.title: Build origin unverified
build_origin.warning: We couldn’t confirm this build came from an official release. Prefer Infinity Horizon downloads and be careful with files from people you don’t know. Built it yourself from source? This warning is expected. Enjoy the game!
crash.title: Azimuth closed unexpectedly
crash.intro: You can send private metadata to help Infinity investigate, or copy a diagnostic report for support. Nothing is uploaded without your permission.
crash.roster_note: Snapshot from {time}; membership may have changed before the crash.
crash.roster_missing: World membership could not be confirmed locally. The service verifies available session history.
crash.blame_unknown: Cause not established. Being in the world or sending the last packet does not identify an offender.
crash.metadata_privacy: The service receives diagnostic codes, build versions and session/world IDs. It resolves participants from its own records. Names, local paths, tokens, chat, raw packets and memory are excluded. Reports support human review; they do not automatically freeze accounts.
crash.metadata_consent: I agree to send diagnostic metadata only to Infinity.
crash.dump_privacy: A local memory dump is available (up to 16 MiB). It may contain sensitive process memory. Saving it creates a file on your computer; the launcher will not upload it.
crash.no_dump: No matching dump is available. You can still send the diagnostic report.
crash.sent: Metadata received for human review. No memory was uploaded and no automatic penalty was applied.
crash.send_failed: Sending did not complete. The local report is kept. You can explicitly retry or copy it for support; an accepted metadata report will not be duplicated.
crash.local_failed: The local copy could not be removed.
crash.frozen: Online access is temporarily frozen for security review. Sign-in and support remain available.
crash.dumps_disabled: Infinity does not receive memory dumps in this phase. Only a separately consented metadata report can be sent.
crash.legacy_action: This pending action uses an earlier report format. Its consent and request will not be reused. Select the metadata consent and Send metadata only to create a separate action; no attachment will be sent.
crash.exported: Diagnostic copied or saved locally. Nothing was uploaded.
crash.export_failed: The diagnostic could not be copied or saved. The original local report is kept.
crash.private_support_help: Share the copied diagnostic with support. Send a memory dump only when requested, in the private support space identified by moderators. Never post a dump in a public channel.
crash.private_support_unset: No support destination is configured. Keep the diagnostic locally until a moderator identifies the private support space; never post a dump publicly.
crash.manual_dump_consent: I understand that the dump may contain sensitive information and choose to save a copy for manual private support.
community.contribution: Community participation is essential to the stability of our online services and a respectful playing environment. Reporting technical issues and inappropriate conduct helps our team investigate and take responsible action. Sending a report is voluntary.
configure.intro: Set up Azimuth before playing online. For Infinity Supporter Hardcore profiles, the launcher also checks your game files automatically.
integrity.title: GAME INTEGRITY
integrity.not_required: Game file checks apply only to Infinity Supporter Hardcore profiles. This profile plays online without them.
integrity.cached: Previous verification remembered. We will confirm the files with the server before starting online play.
connection.snapshot: NAT, IPv6 and public address describe the current host relay when available. They are not measured by the HTTP request. This report does not guarantee lobby connectivity.
integrity.not_checked: Choose your game folder to check its critical files automatically, or check again.
integrity.checking: Checking the selected critical game files with the server. Please wait.
integrity.content_unset: Select the game package folder containing Mount, or Mount itself.
integrity.choose_title: Choose the game package folder or Mount itself
integrity.help: If modifications or an incomplete check prevent online play, share the copied diagnostic with our Discord support team for help. A mismatch does not establish misconduct.
integrity.compatible: The selected critical files match the server's compatibility reference.
integrity.incompatible: Some selected critical files differ from the server's compatibility reference. Online worlds are unavailable. Verify the installation or contact support for help.
integrity.inconclusive: We could not verify all selected critical files. Online worlds remain unavailable. Retry the check or contact support.
integrity.policy_unavailable: The server's compatibility check is unavailable. Try again before playing online.
integrity.invalid_content: Choose the game package folder containing Mount, or Mount itself. The manifest and executable must be present and readable. On Linux/Proton, select your game folder normally; no custom drive mapping is required.
integrity.local_failed: The game-folder choice could not be saved. Check access permissions and try again.
integrity.cancelled: The check was cancelled. It runs again automatically before you play online.
integrity.copy_failed: The diagnostic could not be copied. Try again.
integrity.reason.unapproved_file: File differs from the server's compatibility reference.
integrity.reason.unsafe_path: File location cannot be verified safely.
integrity.reason.scan_limit: File exceeds the verification size limit.
worlds.integrity_incompatible: Online lobbies are unavailable because a critical file differs from the server's reference. Return to the Launcher to verify it or get help.
worlds.integrity_inconclusive: Online lobbies are unavailable while the selected critical files or server permission cannot be verified. Return to the Launcher to check the installation or get help.
updater.title: Infinity Launcher updates
updater.checking: Checking the latest official release and online compatibility…
updater.current: Your launcher is compatible with the latest release and server policy.
updater.required: A launcher update is required before you can play online.
updater.unavailable: We could not verify launcher compatibility with the server. Check your connection and try again before playing online.
updater.release_unavailable: We could not find the latest launcher release on GitHub. You can continue, but your online experience may be affected.
updater.downloading: Downloading the verified update. Your current installation remains available until the update is ready.
updater.applying: Restarting to apply the update. Please wait.
updater.failed: The update could not be completed. Try again or contact support. Online play stays unavailable until the launcher is compatible.
updater.recovery: A previous update needs recovery before online play. Restart the launcher or contact support.
updater.help: Keep your launcher up to date to access online services. Your account, diagnostics and support remain available. Close your session normally before updating.
updater.session_required: Update Infinity Launcher after this game session to return online. Your progress keeps saving.
updater.location: Move or extract Infinity Launcher into its own writable folder, separate from Azimuth and the game files, then try the update again.
online.title: Online service status
online.unknown: We could not confirm online availability. Check your connection and try again before starting an online session.
online.budget: Online play is paused because the service has reached its monthly budget. You can keep playing offline; your progress stays on this PC.
online.operator: Online services are temporarily paused. You can keep playing offline; your progress stays on this PC.
online.resume: When services return, check the status and start a new session when you are ready. Your current game will stay offline.
online.support_help: Support and local diagnostics remain available. Sign-in and account creation will be available when online services return.
online.available_help: You can sign in and start a new online session when you are ready. An earlier offline session will not reconnect automatically.
worlds.dedicated_running: Lobbies are unavailable while this launcher hosts a dedicated lobby. You can keep playing.
lobby.title: Dedicated lobby
lobby.subtitle: Host a lobby from this launcher, without the game. It stays open while the launcher runs.
lobby.name: Lobby name
lobby.max_players_hint: Guests, from 2 to 12. The host is not a player.
lobby.running_hint: While it runs, lobbies in the game's overlay are unavailable on this PC. You can still play.
lobby.close_hint: Stopping it or closing the launcher closes the lobby. Stop it before signing out or changing the game or profile.
lobby.role_required: Only administrators can host dedicated lobbies.
lobby.unsupported: This server does not support dedicated lobbies yet.
lobby.in_use_elsewhere: Another device is already hosting a dedicated lobby for this account.
lobby.session_ended: The dedicated lobby's online session ended.
lobby.update_required: Update Infinity Launcher to host a dedicated lobby.
lobby.online_paused: Online services are paused, so the dedicated lobby closed.
lobby.start_failed: The dedicated lobby could not start. Try again in a moment.
lobby.another_launcher: Another Infinity Launcher is open on this PC. Close it to host a dedicated lobby here.
lobby.no_profile: Choose a game and a profile first: the lobby uses the profile's mode.
lobby.unavailable: Dedicated lobbies are unavailable on this server.
lobby.session_lapsed: The dedicated lobby's online session lapsed (sleep or a lost connection).
lobby.taken_over: This account signed in on another launcher, so the dedicated lobby closed.
lobby.deletion_pending: This account is scheduled for deletion, so it cannot host a dedicated lobby.
lobby.overlay_hosting: Close your in-game lobby first: this PC can host one lobby at a time.
lobby.port_in_use: The lobby's world server could not start: UDP port 5101 is in use (another launcher or an in-game lobby on this PC).
mods.catalog_dev: Development catalog. Mod capabilities and requirements come from manifests.
mods.catalog_unloaded: The mod catalog has not loaded yet. Use the refresh button to load it.
mods.catalog_failed_host: The mod catalog at {host} couldn't be loaded. Check its address and your connection, then try again.
mods.action_done: Mod files updated. Settings were kept.
mods.transaction_failed: The mod operation could not finish. No conflicting files were overwritten. Check folder access, file changes, or recovery status and try again.
mods.progress.title: Updating mods
mods.progress.hint: Please keep the launcher open. Controls will return when the operation finishes.
mods.progress.prepare: Checking files and preparing the operation…
mods.progress.catalog: Loading the mod catalog and manifests…
mods.progress.apply: Applying file changes and recording backups…
mods.catalog_subtitle: Browse mod files, dependencies and settings. Only reviewed releases can be installed.
mods.settings_changed: Settings changed outside the launcher. Your edits are kept. Use Undo to reload the current file.
mods.search: Search mods by name or author…
mods.needs_dependency: Install and enable {mods} first; then this mod can be installed.
mods.depended_on_by: Enabled · {mods} depends on it, so it stays on while that mod is enabled.
mods.needs_hook: This mod changes the game database, which needs the Infinity hook 0.3.0+fh2online.85 or newer. Install or update the hook on Configure first.
mods.native_unavailable_play: Native mods are on, but the Infinity mod runtime isn't installed and couldn't be installed from the catalog. Check your connection, or disable them on Mods to play.
mods.native_hook_required: Native mods online need the official Infinity hook with mod support. Reinstall the hook in Configure, or disable the native mods.
mods.online_unverified: Your multiplayer mods' files don't match their installed versions, so modded lobbies can't be used. Open Mods to repair them, or disable them to play without mods.
mods.online_failed: Your mods could not be confirmed by the Infinity mod runtime, so this session can't host or join modded lobbies. Close the game and try again, or disable the mods.
mods.runtime_failed: The mod session could not start or ended unexpectedly.
mods.catalog_production: Infinity's official mod catalog. Every download is checked against its listed hash.
mods.catalog_cached: Offline: showing the last catalog loaded.
mods.catalog_expired: The catalog has expired. Installed mods keep working; new installs and updates wait for a fresh catalog.
mods.native_unavailable: Needs the Infinity mod runtime: none is installed and this catalog doesn't list one.
mods.update_summary: Version {from} to {to}. Files added: {added}, removed: {removed}, changed: {changed}. Settings new: {settings_added}, removed: {settings_removed}. Your settings are kept.
mods.updated: Mod updated. Your settings were kept.
mods.drift_warning: Some files changed outside the launcher (another tool or a game update). Online access is still decided by the content check.
mods.disabled_kept: Mod disabled. Files changed outside the launcher were kept.
mods.settings_issues: The settings file has values the mod does not accept.
mods.repaired: Settings repaired. A backup of the previous file was kept.
mods.uninstalled: Mod uninstalled: its files left the game. Its settings stay, and the launcher keeps its files on this PC when it can, so installing it again needs no download; Remove from this PC deletes them.
mods.purge_hint: Deletes this mod's files kept on this PC since its uninstall. Installing it again reads it from its source again.
mods.purged: The mod's files were removed from this PC.
mods.recovery_here: A mod change in this Azimuth folder was interrupted. Recover finishes or undoes it; Play waits until then.
mods.recovery_elsewhere: A mod change in another Azimuth folder was interrupted. Mod changes wait until it is recovered; Play is not affected.
mods.recovery_problems: An installation record could not be read.
mods.resolve: Keep current files and close it
mods.resolve_hint: Use this when recovery cannot finish. Mod files stay as they are now; a changed session database returns to the original and the changed copy is kept in the launcher's backups.
mods.resolved: Interrupted operation closed. Review any mod marked as needing attention.
mods.relink_hint: This Azimuth folder looks like a moved installation with managed mods.
mods.state_unreadable: Mod state could not be read. Play is not blocked; open Mods for details.
mods.play_blocked: An interrupted mod operation in this Azimuth folder must be recovered before playing. Open Mods to recover it.
mods.play_warning: Some mods need attention. Open Mods to review them.
integrity.mediaoverride: Hardcore needs the game's media overrides to hold only files of your enabled mods that don't affect multiplayer. Remove or restore these files, then play again: {paths}
mods.runtime_ended: Your selected mods failed to start, so Infinity closed the game. Open Mods to review them, or disable them to play without mods.
mods.prepare_failed: Mods could not be prepared for this launch. Open Mods, or disable the mods to play without them.
mods.error.game_running: Close the game before changing mods.
mods.error.drift: Files changed outside the launcher. Use Accept current files or Disable, keep current files.
mods.error.dependency: Check this mod's dependencies: they must be installed, enabled and set as required, and mods that depend on it must be disabled first.
mods.error.conflict: Another mod or an existing file conflicts with this mod.
mods.error.recovery: An interrupted mod operation needs a decision. Use Recover, or Keep current files and close it.
mods.error.linked: Linked folders inside the game or Azimuth folders are not supported for mods.
mods.error.protected: This mod would change a file the launcher protects.
mods.error.digest: A downloaded or backed-up file did not match its expected hash. Nothing was changed.
mods.error.download: The mod could not be downloaded from its official source.
mods.error.unsupported: This mod needs capabilities this launcher does not support yet.
mods.error.busy: Another launcher window is changing mods. Try again when it finishes.
mods.error.locked: This setting is locked by Infinity.
mods.error.catalog: The mod catalog could not be verified.
mods.error.settings: A setting value is not valid. Check numbers and choices.
mods.error.relink: This installation's records belong to another folder. Use Link the moved installation.
mods.hardcore_refused: Hardcore profiles can't use mods that affect multiplayer: {mods}. Disable them or play a Noob profile.
mods.hardcore_unavailable: Unavailable on this Hardcore profile: this mod affects multiplayer.
mods.error.hardcore: Hardcore profiles can't enable mods that affect multiplayer. Play a Noob profile to use this mod.
mods.error.unconfirmed: Confirm this custom mod first: it isn't reviewed by Infinity.
mods.data_sql_runtime: Needs the Infinity mod runtime with data-mod support (database changes), and an Infinity hook that applies database changes. Reload the mod catalog, or update the hook on Configure.
mods.error.runtime_required: This mod changes the game database and needs the Infinity mod runtime with data-mod support, and an Infinity hook that applies database changes. Reload the mod catalog, or update the hook on Configure.
mods.error.database_base: Another enabled mod already replaces the game database. Only one car pack that replaces the database can be on at a time.
mods.error.database_base_named: {mod} already replaces the game database. Only one car pack that replaces the database can be on at a time: disable it first.
mods.custom_confirm_text: This mod is not reviewed by Infinity. It comes from files you placed in the custom mods folder; Infinity only checks that they match its manifest before installing them, with backups of anything they replace. It can break your game or your saves, and it marks your online lobbies as modded: only players with the identical pack can join. Continue only if you trust where it came from. Each new version of the mod asks again.
mods.custom_executable: It contains executable code, which runs with your game.
mods.custom_problems: {count} custom mod folders could not be read
mods.custom_problems_one: 1 custom mod folder could not be read
mods.custom_folder_failed: The custom mods folder could not be opened. Its path is shown above.
mods.url_title: Add a custom mod from a URL
mods.url_hint: Paste an HTTPS link to a ZIP holding one custom mod (an infinity-mod.json with a custom. id, plus its files/ and database/ folders). Infinity checks every file and creates the mod's folder for you; you still confirm the mod on its card before installing.
mods.url_added: {mod} was added to your custom mods. Review and confirm it on its card to install.
mods.url_replaced: {mod} was updated. The previous folder was kept in mods/custom/.replaced.
mods.url_unchanged: {mod} is already in your custom mods with these exact files.
mods.progress.url_verify: Finding the manifest and checking every file…
mods.error.url_download: The ZIP could not be downloaded. Check that the link is HTTPS and points straight at the file.
mods.error.archive: The download is not a usable mod ZIP: it is damaged, too large, or misses a file its manifest lists.
mods.error.archive_manifest: The ZIP needs exactly one valid custom mod infinity-mod.json (an id starting with custom.).
mods.url_incompatible_title: This mod isn't compatible with Infinity
mods.error.archive_no_manifest: This ZIP has no infinity-mod.json, so Infinity can't install it. Ask the modder to adapt the mod to the Infinity mod schema: {url}
mods.error.custom_full: The custom mods folder already holds the most mods it can list. Remove one before adding another.
mods.error.external_files: Some of this mod's files from your own copy are missing or different, or haven't been checked yet. Open Set up on its card and choose your copy again.
mods.runtime_catalog_needed: Native mods need the Infinity mod runtime, which comes from the mod catalog, and the catalog couldn't be reached. Check your connection and try again, or disable them on Mods to play.
mods.error.runtime_missing: This mod needs the Infinity mod runtime, and none could be installed. Check your connection and the catalog, then try again.
mods.runtime_with_mod: Not installed · installs the Infinity mod runtime with it
external.card_status: You need your own copy of {hint}. Infinity checks it and copies what it needs; the pack itself is never downloaded.
external.title: Set up {mod}
external.intro: This mod uses files from your own copy. Choose where it is for each item below: the folder itself, any folder above it, or its ZIP. Infinity finds and checks every file, then copies what it needs.
external.different_kept: {count} files in this copy are a different version. Using the copy already stored from your earlier pick.
external.different_kept_one: 1 file in this copy is a different version. Using the copy already stored from your earlier pick.
external.nothing_found: None of this mod's files are in the folder or file you chose. Choose your copy of the pack.
external.notice: Uses files from your own copy of {hint}. This content isn't made or checked by Infinity, and online lobbies only match players with the identical pack.
external.recheck: Check files again or choose another copy…
external.empty_folder: No folders or ZIP files here.
external.reason.source_gone: the folder or file is no longer there (a removed SD card or USB drive?).
external.reason.source_too_large: it holds too many files to search. Choose a folder closer to the pack, such as its own folder.
external.reason.source_not_zip: that file isn't a readable ZIP.
external.reason.source_linked: it's a link (a symbolic link or a junction). Choose the folder or file it points to instead.
external.kept: {count} unchanged files kept from your earlier copy.
external.kept_one: 1 unchanged file kept from your earlier copy.
external.stored_damaged: {count} copied files no longer match. Choose your copy of the pack again.
external.stored_damaged_one: 1 copied file no longer matches. Choose your copy of the pack again.
external.game_folder: This mod adds files to the game, and no game folder is set yet. Set it in Configure (the Game folder button on the Game integrity card), then come back here: your choices stay.
mods.error.game_folder: This mod adds files to the game, and no game folder is chosen yet. Choose it with the Game folder button on Configure's Game integrity card, then try again.
external.replaces:
This replaces {count} files already in that folder. They are backed up and come back when you disable or uninstall the mod. Check it's the right game folder:
{files}
external.replaces_one:
This replaces 1 file already in that folder. It is backed up and comes back when you disable or uninstall the mod. Check it's the right game folder:
{files}
catalog.title: Mod catalog
catalog.unofficial_short: Unofficial catalog: not verified by Infinity.
catalog.unofficial_warning: You're using an unofficial, unverified mod catalog ({url}). Infinity doesn't review what it lists: its mods, including ones that run code with your game or change settings Infinity normally locks, come from whoever runs that catalog. Each download is still checked against the hash the catalog lists. Use it only if you trust its source.
catalog.hint: Use a different catalog: paste the HTTPS address of a catalog JSON file. You can return to the official catalog at any time.
catalog.invalid: Enter an HTTPS address (no port, no #fragment).
catalog.save_failed: The catalog choice could not be saved. Check folder access and try again.
catalog.switched_custom: Now using the unofficial catalog. Its mods aren't verified by Infinity.
catalog.switched_official: Back on Infinity's official mod catalog.
catalog.badge_native: Unofficial catalog · unverified · runs code with your game
news.title: News
news.failed: The news couldn't be loaded. Check your connection; it loads again next time.
news.stale: Couldn't refresh the news. Showing the copy from {date}.
seed.option: Start from one of my profiles
seed.warning: This is only a plausibility check. Use this option consciously: if the source profile is later found with altered progression, this Hardcore profile is deleted from the cloud and your account is blocked until a moderator reviews it. An account can run 5 checks a day (checks and first uploads together).
seed.option_hint: Once the profile is created, the server checks that career right away and shows the result before anything is copied. The other profile's save is only read.
seed.first_launch_body: This Hardcore profile has no career in the cloud yet. Start a new career, or start from one of your profiles on this account if the server's check accepts it.
seed.scratch_detail: A new career: the game starts it with the opening race. Anything this PC kept for this profile is archived on this PC, never deleted.
seed.pick_source: Choose the profile to start from, or untick the option.
seed.checking: The server is checking that career…
seed.accepted: The server's check accepted {source}'s career. Confirm to copy it into the new Hardcore profile: it is checked again when you first press Play.
seed.refused: The server found this career unusual for the play time it recorded, so it cannot start a Hardcore profile:
seed.rate_limited: This account already used today's career checks, so this profile starts a new career.
seed.rate_limited_wait: This account already used today's career checks, so this profile starts a new career. More checks are possible in about {hours} h.
seed.source_used: That profile already started another Hardcore profile, so it cannot start this one. This profile starts a new career.
seed.unavailable: This server does not let this profile start from another one now. It starts a new career.
seed.failed: The profile starts a new career.
seed.no_source_save: This PC has no complete save of {source}: the new profile starts a new career.
seed.hours: {hours} h of play recorded on this server
seed.adopted: {name} starts from {source}'s career. The server checks it again at your first Play; if it refuses then, {name} starts a new career.
seed.copy_failed: The career could not be copied into {name}: it starts a new career.
seed.reason.BUNDLE_INVALID: The save could not be read as a complete save (it may have been read while the game was writing it).
seed.reason.SUMMARY_UNREADABLE: The save's credits, XP or level could not be read.
seed.reason.LIMITS: A number is beyond the game's limits.
seed.reason.PLAYERDB_UNREADABLE: The save's player database could not be read.
seed.reason.FIELD_MISSING: The save is missing its winnings or skill data.
seed.reason.VOUCHER_UNGRANTED: The save holds a free-car voucher this server never granted.
seed.reason.LEVEL_XP_MISMATCH: The level does not match the XP.
seed.reason.TOKENS_SKILL_MISMATCH: The perk points do not match the skill progress.
seed.reason.career_pace: The career is bigger than the play time this server recorded for that profile allows.
seed.reason.ceiling: A number is above what this server accepts for a starting career.
seed.reason.other: Unusual progress for the play time recorded ({code}).
accounts.banned_seed_review: This account is blocked until a moderator reviews it: the profile a Hardcore profile started from was found with altered progression, and that Hardcore profile was deleted from the cloud.
saves.seed_accepted: The server took the career this Hardcore profile starts from (revision {rev}).
saves.seed_refused: The server's final check refused the career this Hardcore profile was to start from: it starts a new career now. The other profile's save is untouched.
saves.rate_limited: The server asked to wait before the next save check. Try again later.
saves.rate_limited_wait: This account used today's career checks: the career this Hardcore profile starts from can be sent in about {hours} h.
saves.seed_not_sent: The career this Hardcore profile was to start from could not be sent as it was checked (its copy on this PC is missing or changed): it starts a new career now.
saves.seed_unconfirmed: The server's answer did not match the career that was sent: the cloud and this PC are compared again before the game starts.
seed.commit_counts: This account may have used most of today's 5 checks, and the first upload is one more. If none is left, the first Play waits until the checks come back.
seed.blocked_title: The career check has to wait
seed.blocked: This account used today's career checks, so {name} cannot send the career it starts from yet. Wait, or start a new career instead.
seed.blocked_wait: This account used today's career checks, so {name} cannot send the career it starts from for about {hours} h. Wait, or start a new career instead.
profiles.delete_body: This erases everything the servers keep for {name}, at once and for good: its cloud saves and their history, its liveries and creations, scores, messages and the rest. There is no undo, and the name {name} becomes free for anyone to take.
profiles.delete_keeps: The save on this PC is kept: it moves to the saves folder's fi-launcher-archive. Your account and your friends stay. You can delete up to 3 profiles an hour.
profiles.deleted: Deleted {name} from the cloud; the save on this PC is archived.
profiles.deleted_not_archived: Deleted {name} from the cloud. The save on this PC is in use and could not be archived now; it stays where it was.
profiles.delete_rate_limited: You can delete up to 3 profiles an hour. Try again in about {minutes} min.
profiles.delete_rate_limited_later: You can delete up to 3 profiles an hour. Try again later.
profiles.delete_in_use: This profile is in use: close the game or wait until its session ends (about {minutes} min), then try again.
profiles.delete_in_use_now: This profile is in use: close the game or wait until its session ends, then try again.
